name: Grand Theft Auto VI
summary: After a botched bank robbery, Lucia and Jason find themselves entangled in a vast criminal conspiracy. Forced to rely on each other, they traverse the diverse landscapes of Leonida, confronting challenges that test their bond and survival instincts

name: inZOI
summary: In inZOI, players assume the role of an intern at a virtual reality company called AR COMPANY. Their task is to manage a neighborhood of virtual individuals known as Zois Each Zoi possesses unique personalities, routines, and relationships, leading to dynamic and emergent gameplay scenarios

name: Fable
summary: A reboot of the beloved franchise, Fable returns with a new narrative set in the whimsical world of Albion, combining humor, magic, and adventure

name: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra
summary: Set during World War II in occupied Paris, players control Captain America and Black Panther as they team up to thwart Hydra's plans

name: Star Wars: Zero Company
summary: A tactical game set in the Clone Wars era, players lead a customizable squad, including Mandalorians and Jedi, on missions across the galaxy

name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
summary: A sequel to the retro-inspired shooter, Boltgun 2 continues the fast-paced action in the Warhammer 40K universe

name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
summary: Capcom revives the classic samurai series with modern graphics and gameplay, blending historical Japan with supernatural elements

name: Saros
summary: From Housemarque, known for Returnal, Saros is an upcoming action game with details yet to be fully revealed.

name: The Witcher 4
summary: CD Projekt Red continues the saga with a new protagonist and storyline, expanding the rich world of The Witcher series.

name: Project Witches
summary: A new IP focusing on witchcraft and magic, offering players a dark fantasy experience.
